is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) populations in northern Benin (Abstract, page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) (Abstract, page 1; Tables 3 and 4, page 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 3 and 4 on page 8 provide genotype counts (1014F/F, 1014L/F, 1014L/L and 119S/S, 119G/S, 119G/G) for An. gambiae and An. coluzzii across all study sites.

african_field_population.evidence: The study collected larvae from field breeding sites in six districts of northern Benin (Methods, page 2; Mosquito collections, page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis data (Methods, pages 2-4).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data at the district level (Kandi, Gogounou, Segbana, Djougou, Copargo, Ouake) (Methods, page 2; Table 1, page 6).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted during the rainy season of 2016 (Methods, page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, new collection effort in 2016 for baseline data prior to an IRS campaign.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Tables 1-4).

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) in six districts of northern Benin in 2016. It reports bioassay results for pyrethroids, bendiocarb, and pirimiphos-methyl, and provides genotype counts for kdr L1014F and Ace-1 G119S mutations in An. gambiae and An. coluzzii.
